The '''Chicken Statue''' is a piece of [[furniture]] that can be obtained only by donating 5 [[Artifacts]] that include the {{Name|Chicken Statue|class=inline}} to the [[Museum]].

If the original is lost, a replacement can be purchased at the [[Secret Woods#Lost Items Shop|Lost Items Shop]] in the Secret Woods for {{Price|10000}}.
